Smoke test: load kusto and parse a simple snippet

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/tree_sitter_language_pack.dart';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"language":"kusto"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('T | count\n', config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
